blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) of the Philippine National Police has issued 40 subpoenas as it continues to investigate the foiled attempt to smuggle into the country 521 kilos of “shabu” (methamphetamine) worth P3.5 billion from Laos on a private jet.
